text: GWM is the global marque of Great Wall Motor Company Limited, a Chinese carmaker headquartered in Baoding, Hebei and listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai. Its 2024 annual report names Baoding Innovation Great Wall Asset Management (59.78% of voting rights) as the controlling shareholder and chairman Wei Jianjun as the company's ultimate controlling shareholder.
short: GWM is the global marque of Great Wall Motor; chairman Wei Jianjun is its ultimate controlling shareholder.

source.name: Great Wall Motor Company Limited Annual Report 2024 (HKEX filing), Section 10 and financial-statement notes
source.quote: The controlling shareholder of the Company is Baoding Innovation Great Wall Asset Management Company Limited ( “Innovation Great Wall ”) and the ultimate controlling shareholder is Wei Jian Jun.

additionalSources.name: GWM Europe, 'GWM Introduction'
additionalSources.quote: GWM (Great Wall Motor) is a global intelligent technology company with fully integrated capabilities across design, R&D, manufacturing, sales and service. Product portfolio includes GWM HAVAL, GWM WEY, GWM TANK, GWM ORA, GWM POER, and GWM SOUO
